name: Add a domain to a project
description: Add a domain to a project Add a domain to the project by passing its domain name and by specifying the project by either passing the project `id` or `name` in the URL. POST /v10/projects/{idOrName}/domains
context:
POST /v10/projects/{idOrName}/domains
Add a domain to the project by passing its domain name and by specifying the project by either passing the project `id` or `name` in the URL. If the domain is not yet verified to be used on this project, the request will return `verified = false`, and the domain will need to be verified according to the `verification` challenge via `POST /projects/:idOrName/domains/:domain/verify`. If the domain already exists on the project, the request will fail with a `400` status code.
Required: idOrName (path) — The unique project identifier or the project name; body (body)
Optional: teamId (query) — The Team identifier to perform the request on behalf of.; slug (query) — The Team slug to perform the request on behalf of.

name: Retrieve project domains by project by id or name
description: Retrieve project domains by project by id or name Retrieve the domains associated with a given project by passing either the project `id` or `name` in the URL. GET /v9/projects/{idOrName}/domains
context:
GET /v9/projects/{idOrName}/domains
Retrieve the domains associated with a given project by passing either the project `id` or `name` in the URL.
Required: idOrName (path) — The unique project identifier or the project name
Optional: production (query) — Filters only production domains when set to `true`.; target (query) — Filters on the target of the domain. Can be either "production", "preview"; customEnvironmentId (query) — The unique custom environment identifier within the project; gitBranch (query) — Filters domains based on specific branch.; redirects (query) — Excludes redirect project domains when "false". Includes redirect project domains when "true" (default).; redirect (query) — Filters domains based on their redirect target.; verified (query) — Filters domains based on their verification status.; limit (query) — Maximum number of domains to list from a request (max 100).; since (query) — Get domains created after this JavaScript timestamp.; until (query) — Get domains created before this JavaScript timestamp.; order (query) — Domains sort order by createdAt; teamId (query) — The Team identifier to perform the request on behalf of.; slug (query) — The Team slug to perform the request on behalf of.
